title: Judge Gift Cards 2022: card flavor text

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The night-sky realm of the gods, whose wonders are said not to belong solely to them.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A figure who reflects on the arrogance of his youth and his humble awareness of all he has yet to learn.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of two rivals whose obsessive rivalry with Mishra was driven by their similarities.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: One of two rivals whose obsessive rivalry with Urza was driven by their similarities.

entities.name: Jetmir
entities.description: A speaker who claims that controlling the Halo means controlling the whole city.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: Something whose control, according to Jetmir, grants control of the whole city.

entities.name: Glavin
entities.description: A man foretold by a witch to die surrounded by unimaginable wealth, which he took to mean he'd be rich.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A speaker who says the true treasures of her world are found in the wild places.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: A being whose light shines brightest in the wild places, according to Huatli.

entities.name: Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun
entities.description: The place named on the card whose flavor text quotes Huatli.

events.summary: A witch foretells that Glavin will die surrounded by unimaginable wealth; until his death he believed it meant he'd be rich.
events.quote: A witch once foretold that Glavin would die surrounded by unimaginable wealth.

relations.quote: it was their similarities, rather than their differences, that drove their obsessive rivalry.
